description.p: Ryofiles is a native Qt 6 file manager designed for Ryoku Desktop and Hyprland. It provides fast local browsing, tabs and split panes, safe file operations, removable-storage integration, Git-aware developer tools, and GIO/GVfs-backed network locations.
Remote operations use a separate GIO backend, and destructive integration such as becoming the default file manager or FileChooser portal is never enabled automatically by installation.
